description.value: This mech takes system damage at every ¼ of HP lost instead of ⅓. Treat a systems failure roll of 16 as landing on the power core in addition to the auxiliary systems damage. As a standard action, the mech can salvage the remains of a destroyed technological construct, vehicle, technological equipment, or similar item (at the GM's discretion) with a level of at least half the mech's tier within its reach. For one round for every 4 levels or CR of the salvaged target, the mech adds +1 to its PP rate, adds +2 to its maximum PP, and gains fast healing equal to ¼ its tier (minimum 1).
